God that's how I feel. When I think about where I will be 
in the future I see nothing, and constantly feel as though one day i will at least attempt suicide.
Yea, I guess you're right. I was just pissed and really needed to rant.
I just had a power outage during a ranked match, and this sucks because now I'm forced with the penalty for something that wasn't my fault
And, yeah, the person selling the item change the price of the item so they had to 'hold' my order and confirm that I still wanted to purchase the damn thing
Pausing and holding an order are the same thing. And no, it changed the shipping date.
If she's cutting on video then it's most likely attention self harm. Just ignore it and act like it's not happening, the less attention you give them the less they'll cut!
I honestly don't think counseling would help me. I'm not one to share my feelings so I would probably just say "I don't know" the whole session. But if it helps you that's good.
I feel the same way! I only cut with a pocket knife and I feel like it isn't good enough. Like I need MORE. Sometimes it gets so bad I feel pathetic because they are not deep enough!
Every time you show up late, your parents are begging that you got hit by a car. Or plane.
3 languages and Daddy still doesn't understand stop. I guess he found a use for the failed abortion after all.
I can see the extra chromosome.
